name: zrndr_span_occlusion_insert_no_depth
description: zRndr_SpanOcclusion::InsertSpanNodeNoDepthTest inserts the pending span into one occlusion column without depth ordering, splits or trims occluded ranges, appends visible outputs, and advances the span pool cursor.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because HLIL still renders depth interpolation as x87 long-double/fconvert temporaries around otherwise typed span-node fields and the reconstructed callback contract.
VC5SP3 compile-only verification is recorded for the production source body; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent zRndr span-occlusion pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4912a0 validates the fastcall spanList and column-index arguments, stack spanCount parameter, pending span insertion into empty and non-empty column lists, no-depth occlusion splitting/trimming, visible output coalescing, column head updates, and g_spanAllocCursor advancement.

The native no-depth insertion smoke verifies empty-column insertion, sorted head insertion before an existing span, interior split into left/right occluder remnants, left-overlap trimming, visible span count writes, visible span array contents, next-link updates, and pool cursor advancement.
